# Schedule a Background Check

#### **Office Location**

**Hamilton County Justice Center**

1000 Sycamore Street, Room 100

###### **Background Check Options\***

**\* _closed on all federal holidays_**

\* **_CASH ONLY. Customers must bring exact change if coming between the hours of 3pm-7pm, as the office cannot make change at that time._**

- **Local**:
  - Hamilton County only ($5)
  - Available 7am-3pm, Monday-Friday
  - Immediate Results
- **BCI**:
  - State of Ohio ($32)
  - [BCI Reason Codes](https://www.ohioattorneygeneral.gov/Files/Publications-Files/Background-Check-Publications/BCI-Background-Check-Reason-Codes-(PDF).aspx)
  - Available 7am-7pm, 7 days a week
  - Results available in 2-7 weeks
- **FBI**:
  - Nationwide ($36)
  - [FBI Reason Codes](https://www.ohioattorneygeneral.gov/Files/Publications-Files/Background-Check-Publications/FBI-Background-Check-Reason-Codes-(PDF).aspx)
  - Available 7am-7pm, 7 days a week
  - Results available in 2-7 weeks

- **Inked Fingerprints:**
  - **$10 per card**
  - **Available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week**
  - **You are responsible for mailing the cards to proper destination**
  - **Results will vary on why the inked card is required**

**Each of the above background check options must be completed in person at the Records Division of the Hamilton County Justice Center. Appointments are not required but suggested.**
